text.tspan: Comms Web ensures the service, then renders
A consuming app never starts a duplicate: ensure reuses a compatible instance or starts exactly one detached child under a lock and proves its identity over the private socket.
1. Is a compatible service already up?
Any incompatible answer — wrong service or api_version, a
mismatched data_dir, or an auto instance whose control
socket identity doesn't match — is refused rather than
replaced. A compatible foreground or supervised instance
Re-probe under the lock in case a peer won the
Serve API + studio on the loopback address
Poll health every 30 ms until it answers
